front.title: A Framework of Intelligence Delivery Network (IDN) for Deep Learning Inference

author.organization: Tsinghua Shenzhen International Graduate School & Pengcheng Laboratory

abstract.t: The rapid growth of AI-powered applications is placing increasing pressure on existing Internet infrastructures. To support more scalable, latency-aware, and privacy-enhanced AI inference services, this document introduces the Intelligence Delivery Network (IDN), a network architecture in which intelligence capabilities are treated as network services that can be described, placed, routed to, reused, and secured across distributed heterogeneous computing nodes. This document describes the motivation, deployment assumptions, system model, architectural components, terminology, and security considerations for IDN. It does not specify protocol details or concrete implementation procedures, which are left to future documents.
